premium.basis: Premium to unaffected closing price on November 13, 2020 (the date of Lilly's first acquisition proposal) of $9.76; dossier states 115% but calculation yields ~130.5%

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or leaks; deal was a surprise to the market.

notes: Deal valued at up to $1.04B including CVR. Cash offer of $22.50 represents a 130.5% premium over the Nov 13, 2020 unaffected close despite the dossier citing 115%. CVR adds up to $4.00 per share upon first regulatory approval. The process was a limited targeted market check after initial partnership discussions with Lilly.
